title: B.A. in Chinese Language and Literature
description: Students are required to complete a minimum of 66 units of courses as follows:

sections.title: Elective Courses
text: Students are required to complete 24 units of elective courses from the following Speciality courses, of which at least one course from category (1) or (2) and one course from category (3) or (4).

notes.text: CHLL courses at 2000 and above level will be included in the calculation of Major GPA for honours classification.

A Chinese Language and Literature Major student who pursues a second Major in Linguistics can be exempted from taking LING1002, 3108 and 4401 by taking CHLL3162, 4161 and 4110 respectively. Units earned can be counted towards both Major Programmes.

A Chinese Language and Literature Major student who pursues a second Major in Fine Arts can be exempted from taking FAAS2117, 3105, 3223, 4106 and 4109 by taking CHLL4403, 4332, 4121, 4401 and 4402 respectively. Units earned can be counted towards both Major Programmes.

notes.text: CHLL courses at 2000 and above level as well as those labeled as # will be included in the calculation of Major GPA for honours classification.

Subject to approval by the Major Programmes concerned, students may opt out of the Double Major Programme and register for the 1st Major Programme only. The decision to opt out is irrevocable. Students who have opted out are required to complete and fulfill all graduation requirements by following the study scheme of the 1st Major Programme as a single major. Students should be aware that such decision may result in a delay in graduation because the requirements of the single major study scheme differ from those of the Double Major Programme.
